hotel_name: Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund

claims.text: The hotel lies on the bank of the Huangpu River in Shanghai.

findings.quote: Right in the middle of all this, on the bank of the Huangpu River, lies Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund
findings.note: States the hotel is on the bank of the Huangpu River in Shanghai.

claims.text: The Grand Bund Suite has a deep round soaking tub in a modern bathroom.

findings.quote: feature a deep round soaking tub in a modern bathroom to further refine the experience

claims.text: The Grand Riverside Suite has a king-size bed with an extensive Pillow Menu.

findings.quote: a king-size bed with quality linens and an extensive Pillow Menu

claims.text: The Junior Riverside Suite has large glass windows facing the river and a chaise longue to enjoy the view.

findings.quote: Large glass windows give you the perfect vantage point of the river, complemented with a deep round soaking tub, carefully chosen furnishings and an elegant chaise longue to enjoy the view from.

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor pool and three relaxation pools.

findings.quote: With an indoor pool and three relaxation pools

claims.text: The fitness club includes a Yoga Studio and a fitness centre.

findings.quote: Take part in a soulful yoga asana in the Yoga Studio, or keep your body in top shape in the fitness centre

claims.text: Spa treatments draw on Chinese, Thai, Indian and Indonesian traditions.

findings.quote: treatments that draw on Chinese, Thai, Indian, and Indonesian traditions
findings.note: Condé Nast Traveler review of the spa.

claims.text: TALES is a rooftop bar on the banks of the Huangpu River.

findings.quote: nestled on the banks of Huangpu River, TALES is more than just a rooftop bar

claims.text: Prince Kitchen is a Cantonese restaurant with signature abalone dishes by Master Chef Mai Guangfan.

findings.quote: An elegant and upscale Cantonese restaurant featuring refined cuisine, including signature abalone dishes by renowned Master Chef Mai Guangfan.

claims.text: Curated experiences range from riverside afternoon tea and bespoke spa treatments to cultural workshops.

findings.quote: Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund offers a variety of curated experiences, from riverside afternoon tea and bespoke spa treatments to seasonal gala dinners and cultural workshops.

claims.text: Lujiazui Financial District is about 10 minutes from the hotel by taxi.

findings.quote:
- Lujiazui Financial District

Distance from hotel: 6 km
Time to get there: 10 mins by taxi

claims.text: All rooms and suites have views of the Huangpu River and the skyline.

findings.quote: with spectacular views of the Huangpu river and the iconic skyline from all of its 130 rooms and suites

claims.text: The Bund Oasis with Romantic Pool room has a private dipping pool.

findings.quote:
Bund Oasis with Romantic Pool

A relaxing oasis where you can unwind in your private dipping pool

claims.text: The spa spans three floors and has an indoor pool.

findings.quote: head to the three-floor spa, an oasis-like retreat with an indoor pool

claims.text: The Banyan Suite has panoramic views of the Huangpu River, the Bund and the city skyline, with personal host service.

findings.quote: The pinnacle of Shanghai experience with unmatched panoramic views of the Huangpu River, the Bund and the city skyline, complete with your personal host service

claims.text: Guests can enjoy a Full Moon Destination Dining experience or a traditional Sundown Ritual at TALES.

findings.quote: Enjoy a Full Moon Destination Dining experience, walk along The Bund, or come to the TALES Rooftop Restaurant and bar for a traditional Sundown Ritual.
findings.note: Things to Do for Couples section.

claims.text: The Bund itself is about 10 minutes from the hotel by taxi.

findings.quote:
- The Bund

Distance from hotel: 2.5 km
Time to get there: 10 mins by taxi

claims.text: Pudong International Airport is approximately 45 minutes away by car.

findings.quote: We are approximately 45 minutes away from Shanghai Pudong International Airport by car.

claims.text: Under a Shanghai regulation, eleven disposable items such as toothbrushes are not proactively provided in guestrooms but are available on request.

findings.quote: the Shanghai Municipal Administration of Culture and Tourism has issued a regulation to minimize and reduce the use of disposable items in the tourism and accommodation industry. Eleven disposable items including toothbrush
findings.note: Establishes the regulation, the eleven items and the toothbrush example.

findings.quote: will not be proactively provided by the hotel in guestrooms. These disposable items are available upon request during your stay.
findings.note: Not proactively provided; available on request.
